description: A bearded, armoured horseman in a turban-helmet with a black plume sits on a dark horse, holding a curved sword and a round shield, in front of a large crenellated fortress gate lit by fire from within. Mounted riders with lances and pennants follow behind in a torchlit dusk, and a domed mosque with minarets stands in silhouette under a stormy sky. It is an oil painting filling the image edge to edge, with no letters, border or frame, and only a small sparkle logo in the bottom-right corner. Nothing gory or nude.
